blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: PFRDA plays a vital role in encouraging structured retirement planning among individuals.
It minimizes old-age financial dependency by securing regular income options.
It strengthens the national economy by promoting long-term savings habits.
Pension fund investments channel long-term funds into capital markets, fostering growth.
PFRDA's dual objective includes social security (reducing old-age dependency) and economic development (capital market growth).
Questions frequently highlight how pension investments under PFRDA serve as a major driver for long-term capital formation.
